causal_conclusion.verdict: ESTIMATOR_INDUCED_APPARENT_DISPLACEMENT: Under Vicon ground-truth camera poses, the reconstructed 3D centroid of monitor_01 exhibits near-zero physical dispersion (std norm = 6.1 cm, well within the ~1-2 cm depth sensor noise). Under estimated SLAM poses, dispersion is 1.7x higher, proving conclusively that apparent motion was hallucinated by SLAM trajectory drift caused by dynamic humans in the foreground, and the monitor remained completely stationary.
